title: Accounts-payable exception resolver

stages.name: matchDocuments
stages.algorithm: Align descriptions, units, supplier references, and delivery context across invoice and order lines. Permit many-to-many matches for split shipments, but preserve ambiguous allocations and do not force every invoice line onto the nearest description.
stages.gate: Exact unit conversions and sum conservation; candidate links retain provenance.

stages.name: classifyDiscrepancy
stages.algorithm: Interpret differences using contract terms and receiving evidence. Distinguish partial delivery, unauthorized substitution, freight charges, and genuine duplication; a repeated invoice number is a signal to investigate rather than a sufficient payment decision.
stages.gate: Every disputed amount derives from exact line calculations and a named discrepancy.

stages.name: resolveAllocation
stages.algorithm: Construct a partial resolution for portions supported by delivery and authorization evidence. Preserve disputed balances, prevent the same receipt from supporting multiple payments, and request targeted confirmation for unresolved acceptance or scope.
stages.gate: Accepted plus held amounts equal the invoice balance after verified credits.

stages.name: prepareDisposition
stages.algorithm: Prepare an auditable recommendation to pay, hold, request correction, or apply a verified credit. Route by entity and delegated thresholds, and explain why undisputed portions may proceed without treating the whole invoice as resolved.
stages.gate: Segregation of duties and current approvals enforced outside the semantic executor.

stages.name: reconcilePosting
stages.algorithm: Compare approved allocations with actual ledger and processor results. Reconcile lost acknowledgments by operation identity, detect subsequent credit notes, and maintain remaining obligations without retrying a payment whose outcome is unknown.
stages.gate: No duplicate posting; ledger balance and approved allocation agree exactly.

operational_details: A supplier sends a corrected invoice with the same number: version documents without assuming a second liability.
A receipt is reused across invoices: reserve its allocatable quantity transactionally.
A credit arrives after approval: invalidate the affected payment amount before release.
Currencies differ: require an explicit authorized conversion basis.
The period closes during review: preserve original service dates and route posting-period changes for approval.
representative_episode: One invoice covers two partial shipments, includes an unaccepted substituted item, and is followed by a credit note during approval.
independent_truth_basis: Exact purchase, receipt, credit, and posting ledgers with hidden semantic line mappings and duplicate traps.
